office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and acts as banker and investment manager for Island County and its local districts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Tony Lam (Prefers Independent Party), elected in 2022 after serving as the office's chief deputy, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Island County Treasurer for four years after 18 years in the office, including eight as chief deputy treasurer; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: 18 years in the treasurer's office, including eight as chief deputy, before winning the seat [S1]
Won the open seat in 2022 with 57.2% of the vote [S6]
Stresses fiduciary duty and experienced management of the county investment pool [S1]
